recommendation: Keep the commit. The current conformance behavior already satisfies FHIR-40956 through the required binding to ValueSet/item-type-useable, and this correction removes a directly related contradiction in the value set description without changing the binding model.
issue_request: FHIR-40956 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire request asking whether Questionnaire should prevent Questionnaire.item.type from using the R5 non-selectable item-type code question.
initial_application: Commit ab6c5dc46b83b18ec448260d6b9d2759b4993c30 first applied the issue by excluding question from the Questionnaire item-type value set. Later commit 96361f6c04af0565a4c3d453debfe32a2d2cb8ec moved the active Questionnaire.item.type required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/item-type-useable, which includes item-type codes but excludes question.
additional_context: The Zulip origin thread and 2023-04-27 FHIR SDC minutes support the narrow decision to prevent item.type=question. The current CI build renders ValueSet/item-type-useable, shows Questionnaire.item.type as a use, and excludes question. FHIR-55181 is a later Resolved - change required issue about guidance for unsupported answer types; it is not applied/published in this run scope and does not reopen the non-selectable question code.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that corrects source/questionnaire/valueset-item-type-useable.xml so the value set description names Questionnaire.item.type and the actual excluded non-selectable code question instead of the nonexistent Questionnaire.type element and nonexistent questionnaire code.
source_changes: source/questionnaire/valueset-item-type-useable.xml: changed the description to say it applies to Questionnaire.item.type and excludes the non-selectable question code.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - change required issue about handling unsupported Questionnaire.item.type answer types; it is not Applied/Published and does not alter the FHIR-40956 exclusion of question.
